reason: Single-configuration absolute-energy cutoff differences do not establish necessity of 800 eV for fixed-composition MLIP training
kmesh: Determine on actual labeling cell; no automatic transfer of 8-atom grids
energy_observable: Difference of relative energies per atom against one preselected same-composition reference configuration
calibration_scope: Approximately 10-20 representative configurations spanning target temperature/volume/phase regimes; this count is a planning suggestion, not a statistical guarantee
prohibitions: No mixing different ENCUT labels without protocol handling
No assuming energy offsets constant from one configuration
No transfer to variable-composition defects without consistent elemental-reference calibration
